events.did: woke in EON's medical bay and found an IV taped to the back of his left hand while strapped down
events.quote_anchor: He looked down and there it was—an IV taped to the back of his left hand.

events.did: swept into the medical bay with a tablet in one hand
events.quote_anchor: A man swept in, tablet in one hand.

events.did: stepped closer with a penlight and swept it across Gabriel's eyes
events.quote_anchor: Andrews stepped closer, producing a penlight, and swept it across Gabriel’s eyes.

events.did: reported that three members of staff stopped what they were doing when Gabriel collapsed
events.quote_anchor: the moment after you collapsed, three members of staff in this quadrant stopped what they were doing.

events.did: ordered Andrews shot in the head before Andrews could finish telling the director
events.quote_anchor: but that was as far as he got before Gabriel said, “Please shoot Andrews in the head.”

events.did: took the handgun from the stone-faced soldier's holster and fired once at point-blank range
events.quote_anchor: Helena smiled. She didn’t have a weapon on her, but the soldier behind her did. She turned and withdrew the handgun from his holster.

events.did: dragged the doctor back from death, and the bullet wounds closed
events.quote_anchor: But as Gabriel dragged him back, fingers aching with cold, the wounds closed.

events.did: rose obediently, crossed to a wall cabinet and retrieved a bottle of naproxen for Gabriel
events.quote_anchor: Andrews rose obediently, and crossed to a cabinet on the wall, retrieving a bottle of naproxen.

relations.did: is the EON doctor who examined Gabriel, found strange neural activity, and medicated him
relations.quote_anchor: “Tests showed some strange neural activity.” Andrews looked from the tablet to him. “But I’m more concerned with what happened after you collapsed.”

relations.did: is the director Gabriel asked to speak to, and who Andrews had called
relations.quote_anchor: Gabriel sighed. “I want to speak to the director.”

relations.did: entered the medical bay trailing in Helena Roy's wake and carried the handgun she drew
relations.quote_anchor: Just then, Helena entered, the stone-faced soldier trailing in her wake.

relations.did: is the man whose collapse was followed by three EON staff freezing up and showing no neural activity
relations.quote_anchor: And when I examined one of them,” he said, putting the penlight back in his pocket, “they showed no neural activity at all.

numbers.did: says thirteen guards still need to be converted, including the six in the canteen
numbers.quote_anchor: “Including the six in the canteen,” she said. “Thirteen.”

numbers.did: three members stopped what they were doing when Gabriel collapsed
numbers.quote_anchor: the moment after you collapsed, three members of staff in this quadrant stopped what they were doing.

numbers.did: shaking two pills into his palm and instructing the doctor to clean up the blood
numbers.quote_anchor: Gabriel took it, shaking two pills into his palm as he instructed the doctor to clean up the blood and carry on,

numbers.did: had toured the EON medical bay on his first day
numbers.quote_anchor: He had toured it his first day, noting the cluster of exam rooms, the surgery, the sublevel morgue.
